As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero , a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit .

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters
Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?
Agero is actively seeking Remote Response Associates to join our Roadside Assistance department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!
As a Remote Response Associate , you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.
Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

Handle High-Volume Calls: Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.

•
De-escalate & Support: Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.

•
Navigate Digital Tools: Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.

•
Excel in a Virtual Team: Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

As Spacelift ’s GTM motion matures, enablement is the function that determines whether the people in the field can actually run it. We’re looking for someone to own that end of it.
What will you do

• Support customers across multiple channels, primarily shared Slack channels, email/ticketing, with live calls and screen-shares for complex or urgent issues.

• Reproduce customer-reported issues and isolate root cause - reading logs, APM traces, and run history to tell a genuine product bug apart from a configuration issue or an upstream provider change.

Requirements for the Position

We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle

The Opportunity

You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50-100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.

You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.

- Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

 

Who you are

- Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

- Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

- Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

- Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

- Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
​
​

Job Description - Software Engineering Manager
Reports To - Director of Engineering
Summary
AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI.
You've been a software engineer, so you know what it takes to build software. But your true calling is creating the environment where engineers thrive, succeed, and grow.
That job is changing fast. We're no longer coding everything by hand. We're building the systems that let us bring great ideas to life and solve real customer problems quicker than ever before. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)
There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and you'll be building and leading the teams that do it.
We're looking for a manager who's already internalized this shift. Someone who pushes their team to use AI tools aggressively, but who also has the judgment to know when the AI is producing confident-sounding garbage, and who's building that same judgment in their engineers. Someone who helps their team develop taste and discipline, not just speed.
What You'll Do
Own the day-to-day health of your teams. Help engineers develop great daily habits, strong communication, and reach the next level, including helping them grow from engineers who only write code into engineers who direct AI effectively.
Partner with product and design counterparts to quickly get from "important customer problem" to "working software," favoring rapid iteration over upfront resolution of every ambiguity. Partner with staff engineers on technical direction, code design, and systems thinking.
Set a high standard of excellence and lead by example, including in how you and your team adopt AI tools and rethink your workflows. If you're asking your engineers to embrace this shift, you'd better be living it yourself. Stay hands-on by running spikes, prototyping, and exploring ideas your team hasn't had time to chase, without taking on critical-path work.
Coach engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build: when to trust the output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing. Teach them to fish rather than doing it for them.
Challenge your team's assumptions about how software gets made. Question old habits inherited from the era of scarce coding time (exhaustive PRDs, excessive backlog refinement, premature mockup fidelity, story-point ceremony) and encourage cheaper, faster paths to working software.
Create an environment where engineers think about the whole problem, not just the code: understanding customer needs, system dynamics, and what it takes to run software reliably in production. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly, so clear thinking about what to build matters more than ever.
What We're Looking For
An AI power user with substance and good judgment. You drive agents, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and you're actively rethinking what engineering management looks like when writing code is no longer the bottleneck. You help your team move fast with these tools without becoming dependent on them for the thinking. You know the difference between leveraging AI and outsourcing your brain to it.
A systems thinker. You look beyond the element at hand to the broader dynamics at play.
A strong writer and compelling storyteller. Remote work demands clear writing, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI. But clarity alone doesn't motivate people. You know how to tell the story of why the work matters, where the team is headed, and what winning looks like.
A humble, always-a-student approach to management

title: Senior Geochemist
description:
About the Company 

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear - even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models-alongside our novel sensors-to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. In the eight years since founding, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

 

About the Role

KoBold explores across several continents and a widening set of commodities. This role is the geochemical capability that travels with those programs.

Reporting to the Principal Geochemist, you will work as a functioning member of exploration teams in North America, Europe, and Africa; planning and running sampling campaigns, on the ground when it matters, and turning results around quickly enough to change what the team does next.

The Principal Geochemist has responsibility for company-wide standards, independent data quality assurance, and global method and technology development. Your responsibility is in the practice, programs, field decisions, interpretation, and the day-to-day geochemical judgement that the exploration teams you work within depend on. You will work closely with data scientists and software engineers to develop new tools and drive an ever deepening analysis of results. You will work to company standards and audit against them in the field. You will be required to prioritize your time effectively across multiple projects, and multiply your reach by training field teams to sample well without you present.

 

Responsibilities

• Demonstrate in all activities a commitment to the highest standards in health and safety, environment, and community relations

• Act as the embedded geochemist for exploration programs across North America, Europe, and Africa, joining project teams for the phases where geochemical decisions are being made and providing insight to existing hypotheses and the generation of new hypotheses fast enough to influence exploration decision making

• Design geochemical sampling programs fit for the terrain, regolith, and mineral system being tested, including orientation surveys and the choice of sampling medium, horizon, size fraction, spacing, analytical suite, and digestion, across glaciated terrain, deeply weathered tropical profiles, and arid or transported cover

• Own the geochemical component of drilling programs: sampling intervals and sample support, preparation protocols, quality control insertion, and real-time review of incoming assays against the geological model

• Apply and audit KoBold's geochemical standards

title: Sr Growth Product Manager
description:
About Community Phone Company
Community Phone Company YC W19 built a simple cloud phone system for businesses that don't operate a call center.
Our solution lets a business get all modern voice features (re-route if busy, greeting menu and IVR, programmable caller ID, cloud voicemail, etc) on their existing office phone and existing employee cell phones. All employees onboard instantly, no wifi required, no app to download. Businesses should not be missing out on orders because they can only take one call at a time, and they shouldn't need an IT person in order to get a modern business phone system.
About the role
The company
Communications for the aging in America is broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." James Graham started this company after seeing his own grandmother get taken advantage of by the large telecom hegemony.
They are checking her bank account daily because they cannot tell if she is being scammed. They are calling three times a day because she did not pick up and they do not know if she is okay. They are lying awake wondering if she is connected to anyone, or just sitting alone. And at the most basic level, a lot of their phone service is completely unreliable or breaks entirely for the family once she reaches a certain age.
There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone.
Community Phone is fixing that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, no setup required. We wrapped it with AI-powered check-in calls that surface how she is really doing. And we built a family app that replaces daily dread with genuine safety and peace of mind.
It is working. We are well into 8-figure subscription ARR, pacing to 9-figure, with 25,000+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply to them. Customers stay. They refer their friends. They tell us we took away an anxiety they had carried for years.
We are a lean, product-driven team. The people who thrive here take full ownership, are mission-driven, move quickly, and care deeply about the customer. One of our product engineers won an Oscar for best foreign film, one team member is a Thiel Fellow, one is a Harvard Philosophy PhD dropout, others are the first growth hires at now Unicorn companies, other of our product engineers are former leaders of 60+ person engineering organizations, and many are former founders.
The opportunity
We have 25,000+ families paying us every month for something they deeply value. Churn is low. NPS is high. The upsell products are built and ready.
What does not exist yet is the motion to move customers into them: the trigger identification, the experiment infrastructure, the lifecycle sequences, the in-product moments that surface the right product at the right time to a customer who already trusts us.
That is what this role builds. From scratch. Owned entirely by you. With a clear revenue target, a strong data foundation, and a direct line to product leadership and the CEO.
In year one, the PLG expansion opportunity alone is in the low millions of ARR. That is not a stretch goal requiring new customers or new channels. It is sitting in the base we already have, waiting for the right motion.
And that is just year one. The bigger picture: we are building the definitive platform for aging in place. Phone service is the wedge. Check-in calls, the family app, and products we have not built yet are the expansion. The PM who builds the upsell motion now is building the system that monetizes everything that comes after it.
What you will own

• Expansion revenue from our consumer subscriber base, measured in ARR

• The full upsell motion: trigger identification, experiment design, in-product nudges, lifecycle sequences, pricing page, and onboarding flows

• A prioritized roadmap of PLG experiments, run with shared engineering resources and a strong bias toward non-eng levers where possible

title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Netherlands
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Netherlands
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in the Netherlands. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
description:
About CircleCI Engineering
CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.
At CircleCI , our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.
About Delivery Engineering
Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.
Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.
We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.
What You'll Do

•
Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

•
Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.

•
Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.

•
Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.

•
Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.

•
Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.

•
Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

•
Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.

•
Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.

•
A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.

•
Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.

•
A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.

•
Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role sits at the point where that technology is being built and operated in an agentic-first way. As coding agents take on an increasing share of the software lifecycle, the engineer's role shifts from hand-writing code to directing, specifying, and verifying the output of a fleet of specialised agents, working through a structured harness of guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that transforms raw model capability into production grade engineering. This role ensures that Business Insurance concepts, entities, relationships, metrics, rules, and behaviors are explicitly modeled and consistently applied across data products and AI systems. The role enables reuse, trust, reasoning, semantic interoperability, and scalable AI adoption across underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, customer, product, and portfolio domains.

Operating at the intersection of business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, this role translates complex insurance domain knowledge into production-ready semantic assets that are consumable by both humans and machines.

• Lead the design and execution of enterprise-scale semantic layers for the Business Insurance data portfolio to standardize business meaning and enable trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases.

• Define and operationalize ontologies, context graphs, and knowledge graphs across Business Insurance domains to power reasoning, explainability, and decision intelligence.

• Model core insurance concepts and relationships spanning customers, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance.

• Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics by ensuring large language models and agents can consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships.

• Define canonical semantic vocabularies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured Business Insurance data sources.

• Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, governance, security, and lifecycle management.

• Define and promote standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, and ontology reuse across delivery teams.

• Partner with Business Insurance data product owners, domain leaders, architects, and engineers to embed semantic models into data products, AI pipelines, analytics, and activation layers.

• Work closely with AI Data Architects and AI Data Engineers to operationalize ontologies through graphs, metadata services, APIs, and production data platforms.

• Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards.

• Enable explainability by ensuring AI and analytical outputs can be traced to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data.

• Serve as the principal authority for semantic engineering, ontology, and graph-modeling practices supporting the Business Insurance data portfolio.

• Advance agentic data engineering through reference patterns, playbooks, proofs of value, and production deployments.

description:

Our business is growing and we want to connect with the best Sales and Hospitality professionals across our markets.

If you are interested in our business, have a passion for hospitality or scaling startups, but do let's talk!

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more:

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 2 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

More about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible time off

- Team events

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior People Business Partner
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior People Business Partner to lead the People agenda in Japan and help our local business scale.

You will be the senior People partner to our Japan leadership team, working closely with the VP and Country Manager to translate business priorities into practical plans for our people and organisation. Reporting to the Director of People, APJ, based in Australia, you will bring local expertise into regional decisions and ensure our global approach works effectively in Japan.

This role combines strategic partnership with hands-on delivery. You might spend one part of your day advising a leader on team structure or coaching a manager through a performance conversation, and another resolving an employee issue or improving a local process. You’ll take ownership across that range, knowing when to act independently and when to bring in specialist support.

Your primary focus will be Japan, with the opportunity to contribute to other markets in the region as the business develops.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will help leaders build effective teams, support employees through change, and ensure the day-to-day People experience runs well. That requires sound judgement, strong relationships, and the willingness to follow through on both significant decisions and operational details.

Specifically, you will:

- Partner closely with the VP and Country Manager of Japan and local leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and the people implications of business decisions.

- Translate business priorities into a focused local People plan, balancing the needs of a growing team with longer-term organisational development.

- Coach managers on setting expectations, giving direct feedback, developing talent, and addressing performance concerns early and effectively.

- Lead employee relations matters in Japan with discretion and sound judgement, working with Legal and specialist advisers where appropriate.

- Own the local delivery of People activities across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and development through role changes and offboarding.

- Coordinate with regional and global colleagues, Finance, and external providers on local operational requirements, including benefits, payroll inputs, employee documentation, and accurate records.

- Ensure local policies and practices reflect Japanese employment requirements and align with Legora’s broader People approach.

- Deliver performance, talent, compensation, and engagement processes in Japan, helping leaders turn these into useful decisions and actions.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring

title: Network Operations Manager (US - Remote)
description:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

The Network Operations Manager will establish and lead the management system that enables Network Operations to deliver reliable, predictable and continuously improving production services. This leader converts operational data into action, turns repeatable work into automation, strengthens cross-functional production governance and ensures that new products, services and releases are operationally ready before they enter steady-state support.

This is a highly technical role that requires hands-on involvement in day-to-day operations, debugging, and execution. The successful candidate will create practical standards, operating rhythms and measurable controls while developing a small, high-impact team. The role partners closely with Support, Operations, SRE, Engineering, DevOps, QA, Database Engineering, Product and Security.

Role mandate

• Build and lead the Operational Excellence function, including its operating model, roadmap, governance and talent.

• Own the automation and tooling strategy for Network Operations, prioritizing work that reduces manual effort, repeat incidents and operational risk.

• Define and govern operational-readiness criteria for new products, services and significant changes before production handoff.

• Create the metrics, management reviews and continuous-improvement mechanisms that improve reliability, efficiency and customer outcomes.

What you will own

Operational management system

• Design and run the operational cadence: service reviews, reliability reviews, action tracking, risk reviews and executive reporting.

• Define standards, procedures, controls and ownership models across Support, Operations and Operational Excellence.

• Develop a maturity roadmap and prioritize improvements using service performance, operational risk and business impact.

• Lead root-cause-driven improvement programs and ensure corrective actions produce durable outcomes.

Automation and tools

• Own the Network Operations automation and tools roadmap, intake process and value measurement.

• Guide Automation & Tools Engineers in building self-service workflows, integrations, observability enhancements and safe operational automation.

• Measure automation impact through toil reduction, faster recovery, fewer errors and improved service consistency.

Operational readiness and service transition

• Define production-readiness standards covering observability, alerting, support model, runbooks, SLOs, capacity, resilience, security, recovery, ownership and escalation.

• Review and govern operational readiness for designs created by Engineering; identify gaps, risks and acceptance conditions before launch or handoff.

• Ensure the support and operations teams receive the knowledge, access, documentation, tooling and training required to support new services.

• Track readiness exceptions and post-launch stabilization commitments to closure.

Metrics, insights and continuous improvement

• Build dashboards and scorecards for availability, reliability, incident performance, change health, support quality, toil, automation value and improvement delivery.

• Translate operational data into clear priorities and decision-ready reporting for the Director of Network Op

title: Senior Solutions Engineer

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

MISSION

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai http://Tray.ai).

- Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

- Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

- Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

- Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

- Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

- Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

- Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

- Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai http://Tray.ai.

- Basic programming knowledge (e.g. JavaScript or Python) and working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication (OAuth, API keys), and data mapping.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

- Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

- This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

- Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

- Familiarity with EDI, SFTP/flat-file integrations, or basic SQL.

- Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

WHAT YOU GET

- Work on dig

As Head of Content, your role will include:

- Content Strategy by Buying Stage: You will map content to the questions buyers ask at each stage. Early on, they ask why the software layer matters to an AI cloud or an enterprise AI Factory. Then they ask how the best teams deliver a hyperscaler experience on their own hardware, and finally who else runs this in production. You’ll build separate tracks for AI cloud providers and enterprise buyers, including telcos launching GPU services, Fortune 500 AI Factories and platform teams running clusters across public and private cloud. You’ll also supply each quarterly campaign kit and the Field and ABM team with business cases, account-tailored pages, event follow-ups and nurture content.

- SEO & AEO Engine: You will lead search and AI answer engine strategy across our core topic clusters: managed clusters for AI clouds, Slurm and HPC, tenant isolation, bare metal and infrastructure, inference, and AI cloud economics. On the enterprise side, that includes return on AI infrastructure investment and one tenant experience across EKS, GKE, AKS and bare metal. Each cluster gets a pillar page, supporting technical posts and a clear path to a free trial, demo or conversation.

- Flagship Thought Leadership: You will own the annual State of the AI Cloud report and the content chapters of our year-long brand campaign. You’ll ghostwrite and place bylines, talks and points of view for our CEO and CTO, and build our enterprise narrative for AI Factories, telcos and platform teams.

- Content Production & Proof: You will run one content calendar with DevRel and Product Marketing. Nice to have

title: Dutch Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Languages: Dutch

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$80-US$92.5 per hour

• Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Dedrone protects airspace from drone threats. Each deployment combines our software, our own and partner sensors, and a networking stack that connects the site to DedroneC2 in the cloud. As Engineering Manager for Forward Deployed Engineering, you lead the team that owns the technical outcome at our most critical customer sites.

Your team takes each problem from live triage to a fix in the product. You have the authority to raise defects and to join design reviews with our product teams, based on what your team sees first-hand in the field. One question guides the work: how do we leave the product better than we found it, so nobody has to work this issue again?

What You’ll Do 

Location:  Onsite at our Sterling, Virginia office 4 days a week, and on the road 50% of time
Reports to: Senior Engineering Manager
Direct Reports: 3

• Hire, coach, and develop software engineers and systems specialists across the US and Europe.

• Lead a team that resolves live site problems with customers and installers as they come in, and plan its workload and its place on the engineering on-call rota.

• Run strong operational practices: incident response, root-cause analysis, reviews after incidents, and risk reduction.

• Drive field escalations to resolution with product engineering teams, and make sure each root cause is fixed in the product.

• Own and improve the runbooks, checklists, and acceptance tests that make deployments repeatable.

• Work with sales, services, and support teams on customer deployments.

• Travel to customer sites and events when the work needs it.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools in your daily work, and help the team adopt them well.

• Measure the technical results of the team and report them to senior leaders.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of software development experience, or an equivalent engineering background

• 2+ years in an engineering leadership role, hiring, managing, and developing engineers

• Technical judgment to review designs and code, and to work hands-on during a live incident

• Production operations experience, such as incident response, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and monitoring

• Linux and networking depth to lead live triage and to judge root-cause analysis

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows

• Clear communication with customers, installers, and senior leaders during live incidents, and experience of work across teams without direct authority

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement rigorous frontend experiments to improve the payment product experience and payment success rates

- Identify and quantify opportunities to improve and grow the payments product, and drive roadmaps with those insights

- Translate open-ended business problems into clearly defined data science initiatives

- Build scalable measurement frameworks and strategic north star metrics to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making across teams that directly informs product strategy

- Communicate data insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring findings influence stakeholders

- Mentor and coach junior data scientists, and act as the single-threaded technical owner on cross-functional initiatives

Qualification

- 7+ years industry experience and a degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, Computer Science, Economics). An advanced degree (MS or PhD) is a bonus

- Proven experience in experimentation and causal inference to drive data-informed product decisions with concrete impact

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; proven ability to influence product strategy in high-growth environments

- Strong skills in SQL and Python/R; experience with data modeling a plus

- Experience in technology, financial services and/or a high growth environment is advantageous

title: Kodia - Full Stack Developer
description:
Asiakkaamme Visma Sirius etsii nyt riveihinsä Full Stack Developeria vahvalla back end- ja tietokantapainotuksella rakentamaan modernia SaaS-tuotetta jolla mullistetaan niin kiinteistöjen hallinta kuin vuokraprosessitkin, Kodia tuotekehitystiimiin. Tässä roolissa pääset kehittämään tuotetta, jota käytetään päivittäin kiinteistöalan ammattilaisten työssä; tavoitteena on tehdä heidän arjestaan sujuvampaa ja tehokkaampaa.

“ Markkinoiden moderneimman kiinteistöhallinnan työkalun pariin etsitään nyt devaajaa osaksi loistavaa ja monipuolista tiimiä. Visma Siriuksella Kodia tuoteperheen parissa pääset nauttimaan pienestä ja ketterästä työympäristöstä siten, että tueksesi saat koko Visma-konsernin suuret hartiat. Lähde mukaan kehittämään niin Kodiaa kuin itseäsi seuraavalle tasolle! ” - Markus, rekrytointikonsultti, Talented

Rooli:

Software Developerina työskentelet osana Kodia-tuotekehitystiimiä ja vastaat tuotannollisen SaaS-tuotteen kehittämisestä ja ylläpidosta. Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten tuotetta rakennetaan, miten se skaalautuu kasvavaan asiakasmäärään ja millaisia teknisiä ratkaisuja tulevaisuuden kehityksessä tehdään.

Tiimissä on tällä hetkellä hyvää full stack -osaamista, mutta tuotteen kasvaessa ja datamassan lisääntyessä haetaan nyt mukaan vahvaa back end - ja tietokantapainotusta. Etsimme tekijää, joka nauttii reaalimaailman suorituskykyhaasteiden ratkomisesta ja dataan liittyvien ongelmien huolellisesta ratkomisesta. Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten järjestelmä skaalautuu kasvavaan datamassaan ja kiihtyvään asiakasmäärään.

Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat esimerkiksi:
- Ohjelmistojen laadukas toteutus ja ylläpito (Node.js / TypeScript / React)
- Skaalautuvien ja suorituskykyisten ratkaisujen rakentaminen jatkuvasti kasvavalle asiakasmäärälle ja datamassalle
- Tietokantojen, tietomallien ja datanmallinnuksen parissa työskentely sekä suorituskyvyn optimointi ja statistiikan seuranta
- Integraatioiden rakentaminen ja kehittäminen
- Ensiluokkaisen asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen tuotteen kautta
- Muiden kehittäjien sparraaminen ohjelmistokehityksen parhaissa käytännöissä
- Kehitystyön edistäminen itsenäisesti ja yhdessä tiimin kanssa

Visma Siriuksella hyödynnetään aktiivisesti myös tekoälyavusteisia työkaluja ohjelmistokehityksen eri vaiheissa, ja Visma-konsernin vahva panostus AI:n hyödyntämiseen tarjoaa kehittäjille mahdollisuuden kokeilla ja ottaa käyttöön uusia tapoja tehdä työtä entistä tehokkaammin. Odotamme myös sinulta vahvaa innostusta ja kiinnostusta tekoälyä kohtaan!

Sinä:

Etsimme ohjelmistokehittäjää, jolla on halu tehdä konkreettista ja laadukasta työtä, sekä viedä itseään eteenpäin kehittäjänä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tekemään asioita monipuolisesti osana aktiivista tiimiä ja työyhteisöä. Työtä tehdään hyvin etäpainotteisesti, joten olisi hienoa jos olisit oma-aloitteinen ja tiimityöskentelystä pitävä henkilö, joka uskaltaa rohkeasti ottaa asioista omistajuutta.

- +5-vuotta kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä tuotannollisen softan parissa
- Node.js:n lisäksi TypeScript & React kuuluvat sinun vahvimman osaamisen piiriin
- Innostusta ja kykyä työskennellä tietokantaongelmien, datamallien ja reaalimaailman optimointien parissa
- Hyödynnät jo aktiivisesti tekoälyä ohjelmistokehityksen tukena
- Puhut sujuvasti suomen kielellä
Eduksesi katsotaan:
- Pilviosaaminen (AWS)
- Integraatio-osaaminen
- Aikaisempi kokemus ja mielenkiinto tietoturva-asioita kohtaan
- Aikaisempi kokemus taloushallinnon ja/tai -reskontran parista

Kodia:

Kodia on Visma Siriuksen kehittämä moderni pilvipohjainen SaaS-ohjelmisto, joka on suunniteltu helpottamaan ja tehostamaan kiinteistöjen hallintaa ja vuokrausprosesseja. Se tarjoaa kiinteistöalan ammattilaisille selkeän ja visuaalisen alustan, joka kattaa koko vuokrauksen elinkaaren markkinoinnista ja asukasvalinnasta aina sopimusten hallintaan ja kiinteistön tekniseen ylläpitoon.

Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe.

We are looking for detail-oriented participants to join an audio transcription project supporting the development of speech recognition and conversational AI systems.
Participants will listen to recorded audio conversations and accurately transcribe them into text following project guidelines. The work involves understanding spoken language, identifying speech patterns, and ensuring high transcription quality.

title: Facilities Architect (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

Focused Energy is developing its flagship fusion facility at Biblis, Germany and this role sits at the heart of making it happen. As Facility Development Lead, you’ll own the integrated development plan for Focused Energy’s Biblis facility. You’ll translate technical requirements into coordinated facility, utility, planning, and permitting workstreams, aligning engineering teams with RWE/Biblis stakeholders and external design partners. You’ll drive priorities, dependencies, and decisions so the site can progress through development with a clear, realistic plan.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Define the Biblis facility development direction by translating FE’s technical requirements into a phased, executable site, building, and infrastructure plan.

- Lead the RWE and site-owner interface on facility planning, infrastructure constraints, utilities, and long-term site expansion, collaborating closely with the Senior Construction Project Manager, Translate engineering’s needs into facility requirements across lasers, targetry, diagnostics, controls, cleanrooms, electrical systems, safety and operations.

- Drive German design and permitting strategy by identifying required approvals, regulatory constraints, fire protection requirements, and risk assessment.

- Coordinate external architects, planners, consultants and utilities partners, ensuring their output is aligned with FE’s technical roadmap and decision needs.

- Enable senior decision-making by maintaining a clear, current picture of facility options, risks, assumptions, dependencies, and cost/schedule implications, so engineering leadership can act with confidence and without delay.

WHO YOU ARE

MUST-HAVES

- Experience leading or shaping complex facility, industrial building, infrastructure, or technical site development in Germany.

- Working knowledge of German building, planning, permitting, and compliance processes.

- Ability to translate technical engineering needs into facility, layout, infrastructure, and utility requirements.

- Ability to manage external architects, planners, consultants, or engineering service providers.

- Strong stakeholder interface experience with site owners, authorities, landlords, utilities, or senior external partners.

- Professional German and English language capability.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with energy, nuclear-adjacent, research, cleanroom, laser, laboratory, or high-tech industrial facilities.

- Direct experience with RWE, grid operators, utilities providers, or major German site owners.

- Experience with phased campus or brownfield site development.

- Familiarity with power infrastructure, backup power, grid connection, HVAC, cooling, cleanrooms, or specialist utilities.

- Architectural, civil, building services, industrial engineering, or related professional qualification.

- Experience supporting investment cases, board-level decision papers, or strategic facility roadmaps.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.
